name: Commodore Hotel
accommodation: Side and rear rooms, sea-facing rooms with balconies, and Marine Rooms
suitableFor: Couples and travellers wanting a hotel with dining on site
beachAccess: Overlooks the Instow waterfront; sandy beaches nearby
confirmedFeatures: Strandfield Grill restaurant, sea-facing balcony rooms, estuary views, Tarka Trail access
overview: A hotel in Instow village looking out over the waterfront where the Taw and Torridge estuaries meet, with views across to Appledore. Rooms range from side and rear rooms to sea-facing rooms with balconies, and the Strandfield Grill restaurant serves local produce with estuary views.
surfTripFit: A comfortable hotel base close to Instow's sands, with the Tarka Trail on hand and the Westward Ho!, Saunton and Croyde breaks within a short drive.
